review_scope: Frozen first 32 hash-ranked candidates; source identity and title review only. Outcome values are not used for selection. All native siblings must share a split. Known same-event families consolidated; US 2024 election/transition family excluded conservatively. Pilot v2 uses nonpolitical contracts; geopolitical/political events remain outside this executable experiment. Observation is triggered by the first actual trade at or after each predeclared age, never stale-price substitution. No model evaluation or outcome value was used to revise observation triggering.
